name: Deccan Cements Limited
about: Deccan Cements Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of cement in India. The company offers ordinary Portland cement (OPC), portland pozzolana, and sulphate resistance portland cement products, as well as other specialty cement products, such as rapid hardening, sulphate-resistant, high alumina, oil well cement, and 53-S grade OPC for railway applications. It also engages in the production and sale of power from thermal, hydel, and wind sources; and trades in tile adhesives. Deccan Cements Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
